resources.string: Choose your update and alert preferences.
The app restarts this screen when you change its language.
Check for new rates while the app is closed.
Android may delay checks to save battery or wait for a connection. Intervals are approximate.
Notify when the bank’s buy or sell price changes. This preference is separate from Android permission.
Android has blocked this app’s notifications.
The rate alert channel or its group is blocked in Android settings.
Allow notifications to receive alerts when an automatic check finds changed prices. The first background check is silent; manual refresh never sends alerts.
Automatic checks are off. Background alerts will stay paused until they are enabled.
Could not save that change. Check free storage and try the control again.
Could not open Android settings. Open Settings, find Currency Raise, and choose Notifications.
Available only in debug builds. Sends a labeled sample through the real alert channel without changing saved rates or alert history.
Allow Android notifications before sending a test.
Test notification sent. Tap it to confirm that it opens Home.
The notification could not be posted. Check Android permission and the Exchange Rate Updates channel.
